verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair axis for an AI email client, but the evidence documents no user-definable rules, triggers, or filters that act automatically on events. The MCP tools for labeling, archiving and sending are on-demand actions an agent invokes, not event-driven rules. The founder's mention of auto-categorization describes built-in AI behavior, not user-defined rules, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
